remarks: Welcome to 11 Renwick Street, this charming property offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, minutes from downtown Stamford, providing easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment. Commuters will appreciate the proximity to Stamford's train station, offering quick access to NYC and surrounding areas. The home offers three well-sized bedrooms, formal living room and dining room. Detached 2 Car Garage and fenced backyard, perfect for relaxing, gardening, or hosting summer barbecues.
